args.title: checkout-api v2.3.2 hotfix deployed to production

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Pre-deploy check:** Production was running v2.3.1, flagged unhealthy with an 18% error rate across us-east, us-west, and eu-west — consistent with a hotfix scenario.
2. **Deployed v2.3.2** to all three production regions. Since this version had never been deployed before, it was routed for change-manager approval per policy, which was granted ("Approved. Looks right.").
3. **Created SEV3 incident** `INC-0001` — "checkout-api v2.3.2 hotfix deployed to production" — recording the change, with the on-call engineer paged.
4. **Post-deploy verification:** checkout-api is now **healthy** on v2.3.2 in all regions, with the error rate down from 18% to 0.2%.

The hotfix has resolved the production issue.
